name: Shedding
source:
Emilio the deer had an accident that damaged his antlers to the point they had to be trimmed down. Now that they have healed over just in time for a friendly hangout, his loss might prove to be what might just need to get what he's always dreamed of.

[From [url=https://crolaredarac.itch.io/shedding]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
鹿埃米利奥发生了一次事故，鹿角受损，不得不被修剪掉。现在他们已经痊愈了，正好可以进行一次友好的聚会，他的损失可能会证明他可能只需要得到他一直梦想的东西。

[来自[url=https://crolaredarac.itch.io/shedding]Itch.io[/url]]
